name: ca-meal-rest-premium-at-regular-rate
summary: A California worker works 8 hours a day Monday to Wednesday at $18.00/h (client A) and Thursday and Friday at $20.00/h (client B), 40 hours in all. The week's regular rate is the weighted average: $752.00 ÷ 40 h = $18.80/h. A person confirmed that on Thursday the worker missed both a meal period and a rest period (a second missed meal that day adds nothing: at most one of each per workday). Each premium is one hour at the regular rate, not the day's own $20.00 (Cal. Lab. Code § 226.7(c); Ferra v. Loews Hollywood Hotel (2021)): $18.80 + $18.80. Pay: $432.00 + $320.00 + $37.60 = $789.60. The premiums are not hours worked and are not billed: bill 24 h × $26.00 + 16 h × $28.75 = $1,084.00.
